MYOP-001.scenario: Open My Opportunities with valid Creator token
MYOP-001.expected: Page loads, sends authenticated API request, displays heading and toolbar

MYOP-002.scenario: Verify opportunities displayed from API response
MYOP-002.expected: Cards show title, category, status, description, location, hours, deadline and compensation

MYOP-003.scenario: Search for opportunity by title or description
MYOP-003.expected: Only matching cards appear; result count updates

MYOP-004.scenario: Filter by status and combine with search
MYOP-004.expected: Only opportunities satisfying selected status and search term appear

MYOP-005.scenario: Click Refresh after opportunity data changes
MYOP-005.expected: New API request is sent and displayed opportunities update

MYOP-006.scenario: Search or filter returns no matching opportunities
MYOP-006.expected: Displays No matching opportunities with explanatory message

MYOP-007.expected: Displays No opportunities yet and Create your first opportunity button

MYOP-008.expected: Displays Unable to load opportunities and sign-in requirement; does not fetch protected data

MYOP-009.scenario: API returns error; user clicks Try again
MYOP-009.expected: Error appears; retry sends request and restores cards when successful

MYOP-010.scenario: Navigate using Create Opportunity and View buttons
MYOP-010.expected: Create opens /creator/opportunities/create; View opens selected opportunity details

CRT-001.expected: All four form sections and Save Draft, Publish Opportunity, Cancel buttons visible

CRT-002.expected: Category dropdown displays categories received from backend

CRT-003.expected: Submission blocked; title, category and description required

CRT-004.expected: Inputs accept values and retain entered info before submission

CRT-005.expected: End before start or deadline after start prevents submission with validation

CRT-006.scenario: Enter invalid expected hours or applicant limit
CRT-006.expected: Zero, negative and noninteger values rejected by numeric constraints

CRT-007.expected: Amount and currency fields appear; amount required and nonnegative

CRT-008.expected: Paid-only fields disappear; unpaid submission omits compensation amount

CRT-010.expected: Create request followed by publish request for returned ID; success and navigation

CRT-012.expected: Backend validation information displayed; user remains on form
